js: (async () => { const G = window.G, W = G.WPN, P = G.player, w = ms => new Promise(q => setTimeout(q, ms)); G.opts.ammo = false; if (G.creative.on) G.toggleCreative(); if (P.car) G.toggleCar(); P.aimHold = false; W.give('pistol', 48); W.select('pistol', true); await w(700); G.camPitch.v = 0.2; const p0 = G.camPitch.v; let p1 = p0; for (let i = 0; i < 150 && W.inv.pistol.mag === 12; i++) { G.camPitch.v = 0.2; W.press(true); W.press(false); p1 = G.camPitch.v; if (W.inv.pistol.mag === 12) await w(100); } let p2 = p1; for (let i = 0; i < 150 && !(p2 > p1 + 0.004); i++) { await w(100); p2 = G.camPitch.v; } P.wanted = 0; window.__wg1 = { p0, p1: +p1.toFixed(4), p2: +p2.toFixed(4), mag: W.inv.pistol.mag }; return JSON.stringify(window.__wg1); })()

(async () => { const G = window.G, W = G.WPN, w = ms => new Promise(q => setTimeout(q, ms)); W.select('pistol', true); await w(500); const it = W.inv.pistol; it.mag = 0; it.res = 30; const t0 = performance.now(); W.reload(); const lief = W.reloading; let t1 = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 900 && !t1; i++) { await w(100); if (!W.reloading) t1 = performance.now(); } window.__wg2 = { lief, ms: Math.round(t1 - t0), mag: it.mag, res: it.res }; return JSON.stringify(window.__wg2); })()
expect: (() => { const r = window.__wg2; return !!r && r.lief && r.ms > 1000 && r.mag === 12 && r.res === 18; })()

js: (async () => { const G = window.G, W = G.WPN, w = ms => new Promise(q => setTimeout(q, ms)); W.give('shotgun', 24); W.select('shotgun', true); await w(800); const it = W.inv.shotgun; it.mag = 0; it.res = 24; W.reload(); const t0 = performance.now(); while (it.mag < 2 && performance.now() - t0 < 8000) await w(40); const geladen = it.mag, lief = W.reloading; W.press(true); W.press(false); const nach = it.mag, laedt = W.reloading; await w(1500); G.player.wanted = 0; window.__wg3 = { geladen, lief, nach, laedt, mag2: it.mag }; return JSON.stringify(window.__wg3); })()
expect: (() => { const r = window.__wg3; return !!r && r.lief && r.geladen >= 2 && r.geladen < 6 && r.nach === r.geladen - 1 && !r.laedt && r.mag2 === r.nach; })()

js: (() => { const W = window.G.WPN; window.__wg4 = { p5: W.dmgAt('pistol', 5), p100: W.dmgAt('pistol', 100), s5: W.dmgAt('shotgun', 5), s45: W.dmgAt('shotgun', 45), g100: W.dmgAt('rifle', 100) }; return JSON.stringify(window.__wg4); })()

(async () => { const G = window.G, W = G.WPN, w = ms => new Promise(q => setTimeout(q, ms)); W.give('smg', 120); W.select('pistol', true); await w(700); W.select('smg', true); const it = W.inv.smg; it.mag = 30; W.press(true); W.press(false); const sofort = it.mag; for (let i = 0; i < 150 && it.mag === 30; i++) { await w(100); W.press(true); W.press(false); } const spaeter = it.mag; G.player.wanted = 0; window.__wg5 = { sofort, spaeter }; return JSON.stringify(window.__wg5); })()
expect: (() => { const r = window.__wg5; return !!r && r.sofort === 30 && r.spaeter === 29; })()

js: (async () => { const G = window.G, W = G.WPN, P = G.player, cam = G.camera, V3 = G.THREE.Vector3, w = ms => new Promise(q => setTimeout(q, ms)); const t0 = performance.now(); /* Bild abwarten: auf SwiftShader dauert ein Bild über 1 s, Kamera und Ziele ändern sich nur dort */ const frames = n => new Promise(r => { let i = 0; const to = setTimeout(r, 5000); const f = () => { if (++i >= n) { clearTimeout(to); r(); } else requestAnimationFrame(f); }; requestAnimationFrame(f); }); W.select('pistol', true); await w(700); W.inv.pistol.mag = 12; P.aimHold = true; G.camPitch.v = 0.1; await frames(2); const el = document.getElementById('wgf'), h0 = W.feel.hits; const autos = G.X.shootables.filter(o => G.cars.includes(o) && o.visible && !o.userData.inst && !o.userData.police && o.userData.mode !== 'wreck' && o !== P.car && o.position.distanceTo(P.pos) < 200); const leute = G.peds.filter(p => p.visible && !p.userData.inst && !p.userData.cop && p.userData.hp > 0 && p.userData.state !== 'dead' && G.X.shootables.includes(p)); const ziele = autos.length ? autos : leute; const dy = autos.length ? 0.8 : 1.1; /* wie wallDist() in weapons.js: Strahl bis zum Ziel frei von Gelände und Wänden? */ const frei = (o, d) => { for (let s = 2.5; s < 11; s += 1.25) { const x = o.x + d.x * s, y = o.y + d.y * s, z = o.z + d.z * s; if (y <= G.TH(x, z) || G.solidAtH(x, z, y) !== -1) return false; } return true; }; /* Das Ziel wird vor JEDEM Abzug frisch vor die aktuelle Kamera gesetzt (Kamera, Verkehr und Passanten bewegen sich in den Bildern zwischen den Versuchen; die Pistole hat Wartezeit in Spielzeit, die auf der CI sehr lang ist) */ const platz = c => { cam.updateMatrixWorld(true); const d = cam.getWorldDirection(new V3()), at = cam.position.clone().addScaledVector(d, 10); c.position.set(at.x, at.y - dy, at.z); c.updateMatrixWorld(true); return frei(cam.position, d); }; let sah = false, n = 0, blockiert = 0, versuche = 0; for (let k = 0; k < 16 && !sah && ziele.length && performance.now() - t0 < 48000; k++) { G.camYaw.v = k * Math.PI / 8; G.camPitch.v = 0.1; await frames(2); const c = ziele[k % ziele.length]; const old = c.position.clone(); if (!platz(c)) { blockiert++; c.position.copy(old); c.updateMatrixWorld(true); continue; } versuche++; W.inv.pistol.mag = 12; for (let i = 0; i < 120 && W.inv.pistol.mag === 12 && performance.now() - t0 < 48000; i++) { G.camPitch.v = 0.1; if (!platz(c)) break; W.press(true); W.press(false); if (W.inv.pistol.mag === 12) await w(100); } if (W.inv.pistol.mag < 12) n++; if (el && el.classList.contains('hit')) sah = true; c.position.copy(old); c.updateMatrixWorld(true); if (!sah) await w(300); } P.aimHold = false; P.wanted = 0; window.__wg6 = { ziele: ziele.length, versuche, schuesse: n, blockiert, sah, treffer: W.feel.hits - h0, el: !!el, ms: Math.round(performance.now() - t0) }; return JSON.stringify(window.__wg6); })()
expect: (() => { const r = window.__wg6; return !!r && r.el && r.sah && r.treffer >= 1; })()
